YOUDENOVA Hanging Closet Organizer and Storage

$15.98
Dorm closets are a joke — usually a narrow rod with maybe three hangers' worth of space. This hanging organizer turns that vertical space into six shelves that can hold folded clothes, shoes, toiletries, or whatever else won't fit in the dresser. The grey fabric is basic but sturdy, and the six shelves give you way more organized storage than a pile on the floor. It hangs from the closet rod so it doesn't take up any floor space, and it folds flat for summer storage. One of those things that makes dorm life noticeably less chaotic.
